environment.db_location: Docker container on the same host, loopback
environment.commit: not recorded (shared working tree, uncommitted at measurement time)
environment.noise_note: Shared developer machine; other workers were running test suites concurrently. Numbers are indicative, not a quiet-machine baseline.

append_single_writer.note: one evidence append per committed transaction, real network round trips to PostgreSQL

append_contended_4_threads.note: same tenant: serialised by the chain-head row lock (by design)

append_contended_8_threads.note: same tenant: serialised by the chain-head row lock (by design)

append_contended_4_processes.note: 4 OS processes x 40 appends each, same tenant, per-append latency measured inside the worker

export_200_events_from_100k_chain.note: includes incremental checkpoint, signing, skeleton of ALL chain rows up to the checkpoint, zip, vault store

process_peak_working_set_note: Measurement defect: the ctypes GetProcessMemoryInfo call returned 0.0 (invalid) and is discarded. Only the Python-heap peak (tracemalloc, separate traced rep) is reported: ~25 MB for a full pass regardless of chain length (streaming, yield_per=5000).

met: single-writer append p95 88.6 ms < 100 ms target (p99 115.9 ms exceeds it)
10k full verify 2.5 s max < 5 s target
incremental anchored verify of 100 new events is ~24 ms on both 10k and 100k chains (vs 14.6-20.9 s full on 100k)
missed_or_caveated: contended append (same tenant) misses a 100 ms p95: 4 threads 288 ms, 8 threads 1075 ms, 4 processes 368 ms; throughput 26-35 appends/s. By design all writers of one tenant serialise on the chain-head row lock; this is the throughput ceiling per tenant.
full verification of 100,000 events takes 15-21 s (linear, ~0.15 ms/event); no target was set for 100k, reported as measured.
export from a 100k chain takes ~1.7 s mostly because the skeleton of all chain rows up to the checkpoint is included; it grows linearly with chain length.
honest_summary.noise: shared machine with concurrent test suites; single run, no repeats of the whole benchmark; Docker PostgreSQL on loopback.
